verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API reachable with personal API keys, an experimental Swagger UI available only in dev mode, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints that any OpenAI-style client can call. None of this is an official Open WebUI SDK or client library. Using third-party OpenAI clients against a compatible API is an adjacent building block, not a first-party SDK, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
